tickets.title: Parent: Explore the app and propose 2 new test cases
tickets.description:
Explore https://www.saucedemo.com/ and propose 2 new UI test cases. Do not write any test code in this ticket.

The two tests must not repeat each other or these existing tests: login/logout, sort by price, product in the cart, locked-out user. One must be a negative case (invalid input or a forbidden action; assert the error the site shows). The other must be an edge case (an unusual state or behaviour; assert what the site actually does today, even if it looks like a bug).

For each proposed test, create a new ticket in the Backlog. Do not ask me to create them. Each title is "Child: <test name>". Each description follows this template:

Parent: BB-1
Precondition: <the user (or "no user logged in"), the page and the cart state>
Steps:
1. ...
Expected result:
1. <one observable outcome with an exact value; no two checks joined with "and">
2. ...

End each description with this line, with the placeholders filled in for that ticket:
"When the test is green and the whole suite passes: import it into Barko, commit only this test's files, its new file in .barko/tests/ and the current .barko/ changes, with the subject `Add <test name> (<ID of this ticket>)`, then add the short commit hash as a comment on this ticket. Do not amend the commit."

tickets.title: Child: checkout missing first name
tickets.description:
Parent: BB-1
Precondition: standard_user is logged in, on the cart page (/cart.html), and cart has 1 item.
Steps:
1. Click the "Checkout" button to proceed to checkout step one.
2. Leave First Name empty, enter "Doe" in Last Name, and enter "12345" in Zip/Postal Code.
3. Click "Continue" button.
Expected result:
1. After step 1, the URL path is /checkout-step-one.html.
2. After step 3, the URL path is still /checkout-step-one.html.
3. After step 3, an error message is visible.
4. After step 3, the error message text reads "Error: First Name is required".

When the test is green and the whole suite passes: import it into Barko, commit only this test's files, its new file in .barko/tests/ and the current .barko/ changes, with the subject `Add checkout missing first name (BB-2)`, then add the short commit hash as a comment on this ticket. Do not amend the commit.

tickets.title: Child: problem user sort does not reorder
tickets.description:
Parent: BB-1
Precondition: problem_user is logged in and on the inventory page (/inventory.html). The sort dropdown has its default option, "Name (A to Z)". The page shows 6 products.
Steps:
1. Note the names and order of the products on the page.
2. Select "Name (Z to A)" in the sort dropdown.
Expected result:
1. The selected option of the sort dropdown is "Name (Z to A)".
2. The product list still displays items starting with "Sauce Labs Backpack" and maintains the initial order.
3. The product list still contains 6 products.

When the test is green and the whole suite passes: import it into Barko, commit only this test's files, its new file in .barko/tests/ and the current .barko/ changes, with the subject `Add problem user sort does not reorder (BB-3)`, then add the short commit hash as a comment on this ticket. Do not amend the commit.

tickets.title: Own: remove product from cart updates badge
tickets.description:
Precondition: standard_user is logged in, on the cart page (/cart.html), and the cart lists 1 item.
Steps:
1. Click the "Remove" button for the item in the cart.
2. Click the "Continue Shopping" button.
Expected result:
1. After step 1, the cart item is removed and the cart lists 0 items.
2. After step 1, the cart badge is removed from the header.
3. After step 2, the URL path is /inventory.html.
4. After step 2, the first product's button text is "Add to cart".

When the test is green and the whole suite passes: import it into Barko, commit this test's files, its new file in .barko/tests/ and the current .barko/ changes, with the subject `Add remove product from cart updates badge (BB-4)`, then add the short commit hash as a comment on this ticket. Do not amend the commit.
